_comment: Internal build manifest. node-addon-api is a header-only C++ wrapper around the stable NAPI C surface (node_api.h). No runtime npm deps ship into Discord.
name: discord_voice_codec

scripts._comment_install: Pull node-addon-api headers into node_modules/. node-gyp picks them up via the include_dirs entry in binding.gyp.
scripts.install: echo run build_addon.bat to build the native module
